easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls a permanent that shares a type with the one you intend to donate.
description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Surrak.
Cast Role Reversal by paying {U}{U}{R}, exchanging control of a permanent an opponent controls and Surrak.
Activate the ability granted to Surrak by Martyrdom an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Surrak triggers that many times, causing its controller to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
